scope: Static retargeter reference comparisons on six preexisting development HUG poses plus finer repeats; no generator inference, physics integration, eval episode/label/dataset or predictor fitting.
reference_method: Dex Retargeting 0.5.0 DexPilot-style Shadow reference, not exact original paper or a HUG->Shadow gold truth; same fixed asset and implemented wrist/operator/palm placement convention.
query_domain: Actual compiled disabled visual mesh triangles using exactly saved v4 deterministic area-weighted query sites. Keep collision-union checks separately; no pooled metric.
metrics: Whole-hand and independent anatomical-part unsigned proximity, occupied-or-near union footprint, lost/new/intersection area, per-finger retention; all include poor native poses/penetration. Target unsigned distances to individual collider surfaces; buried interfaces may contribute for penetrated queries. Globally exterior same-nearest-label normal/separation subset with mismatched/unmatched and closest-object-interior categories retained, not paired physical-contact annotations.
native_reference: Immutable saved MANO mesh/labels and cached native distances/winding membership bound to published omission hashes. Closed orientation and source hashes previously checked; verify reused caches and regression before other claims.
target_placement: Native MANO wrist=Shadow palm origin; R_world_palm=R_world_operator*R_base_palm(q). Recompute root pose per method exactly as current convention; initial object unchanged.
reported_normals: Native oriented closest triangle, target nearest primitive/per-geom hull facet; label/proximity/exterior conditioned, no physical contact force or global contact-preservation pass rate.
invariants: time zero, initial object qpos/worldpose fixed, 24 physical named joints, nominal state unchanged during measurement, input/source/model/manuscript hashes unchanged, licensed assets not copied.
scientific_acceptance: No overall contact-fidelity threshold adopted from inspected development cases. Results are descriptive comparisons; shared frame assumptions not independently validated by agreement.
limitations: Same six inspected development source families, one MANO shape; not independent validation or new eval data.
Packaged DexPilot scale/filter/pinch projection can deliberately change geometry; metric-static sensitivity predeclared separately and not chosen per case.
Normals only conditional geometric proxies; source self-intersection/winding occupancy uncertainty remains.
Object collision approximation investigated in separate cause phase; no collider or hand geometry changed.
No continuum convergence, quality guarantee, simulator/source-system equivalence or physical-transfer claim.
amendment_before_any_surface_measurement: Add finite full target per-collider unsigned queries (no 5mm broadphase) for continuous paired-distance profiles. Fixed original masks/bands and query domains retained. V1 unexecuted and preserved.
continuous_distance_profiles: For every native anatomical part with finite distances, report area-weighted mapped-minus-native unsigned-distance distributions across all common visual query sites and native-proximity<=5mm stratum. Min abs(per-collider signed distances), not exterior-union signed distance, and smaller is not automatically more faithful. Native-absent parts remain null.
amendment_before_v3_measurements: V2 stopped on source/captured-scene decimal joint-range discrepancy. Preserve its exact script/protocol/status. V3 validates unchanged targets against full source URDF physical ranges, permits only the actual per-joint URDF-vs-scene range difference plus1e-9rad for static FK, and records every stricter captured-scene violation. No q clipping, scene change or production preflight acceptance; alternative configs remain static diagnostics.
static_range_policy: Exact full-source URDF range hard check with1e-9rad numeric allowance. Compare every bound to saved scene; disclose differences. Captured-scene FK check allowance is measured max absolute bound difference for that joint plus1e-9rad. Report strict saved-scene violations independently, so no claim of strict preflight acceptance is made.
